description: This file defines repository functions for managing code reviews and review results in a database, including creation and retrieval of reviews linked to users.

methods.name: createReview({ userId, language, code, title, status = 'completed' })
methods.description: Creates a new review record in the database with user ID, language, code, title, and status.

methods.name: createReviewResult({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model })
methods.description: Creates a review result linked to a specific review ID, including summary, issues, suggestions, raw result, and model.

methods.name: listReviewsByUser({ userId, limit, offset })
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific user, including optional associated review results.

methods.name: getReviewByIdForUser({ reviewId, userId })
methods.description: Fetches a specific review (and its result) for a user, ensuring ownership verification.

ctags.name: createReview
ctags.pattern: /^async function createReview({ userId, language, code, title, status = 'completed' }) {$/

ctags.name: createReviewResult
ctags.pattern: /^async function createReviewResult({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model }) /
ctags.signature: ({ reviewId, summary, issues, suggestions, rawResult, model })
